evidence: The flow checks isAuthed/authReady and sends a signed-out visitor to sign in rather than letting them fill the form and lose it (marker '#1' in BusinessOnboard.tsx).
The 5-businesses-per-owner cap (mirroring trg_enforce_business_owner_limit) is checked before the form, with 'That's the limit for one account. Manage an existing shop, or remove…' (marker '#2').
The form auto-saves a draft per user (biz_onboard_draft:<uid>) and restores it (marker '#3').
Photos can be removed, and uploaded URLs are tracked so a failed create cleans them up (uploadedRef → uploadService.remove, markers '#4' and '#21').
The cover photo is chosen from the uploaded set (marker '#5').
A photo over 8 MB is refused with its size named: 'That photo is N MB — the limit is 8 MB' (MAX_PHOTO_BYTES, marker '#6').
Location is set by map pin with reverse geocoding (reverseGeocodeFull) rather than typed blind.
Continue explains what's missing instead of silently disabling on absent coordinates (marker '#8').
Reverse geocoding fills empty address fields and doesn't overwrite text the owner typed (marker '#9').
The phone field normalises +91 / leading 0 rather than clipping digits (marker '#10').
Hours are kept when bookings are switched off — the comment at marker '#11' records that they used to be dropped entirely.
The description/bio field is part of the form and saved with the listing (marker '#12').
WhatsApp and email are collected, with 'same as phone' handling (marker '#13' in the provider flow, same fields here: whatsapp, whatsappSame, email).
Category chips render the full name ({c.icon} {c.name}) in a wrapping row, and .chip keeps its text on one line without truncating.
A missing category can be proposed, and the proposed row's own id and name are used when the insert succeeds (marker '#15').
The package suggestion is recomputed live from the chosen category and can be overridden (packageOverride / effectivePackageKey), so a generic category doesn't lock the picker.
The hardcoded '3,247 nearby users' line is gone — marker '#17' records it; the remaining occurrence is in src/screens/future-enhancement/, which doesn't ship.
Finishing switches context to the new business and lands on its console (setContext, marker '#18').
addRole is awaited before refreshUser, so the role is read back after the write lands (marker '#19').
isOpenNow is computed from the shop's hours instead of a flat true, so a shop submitted at midnight isn't published as open (marker '#20').
Every URL uploaded during the attempt is tracked and removed if the create fails; once the row owns them they're no longer orphans (marker '#21').
The redundant second submitForReview round trip is gone — create already writes status PENDING (marker '#22').
trg_notify_admins_business_pending exists on public.businesses (production, 2026-09-16), so admins are told about a new submission. E2E critical/business-onboarding drives submit → admin approve.
The confirmation screen says the listing is under review ('… • Under review', plus 'We'll verify your business within ~24 hours').

Every signed-in user without onboardingCompletedAt is sent to /auth/onboard by the layout gate, whichever way they signed in (marker '#1' in UserOnboard.tsx; E2E-029 added the same gate to the guest-or-auth screens).
The location search is debounced (marker '#2' in the location beat).
The beat pointer is stored per account, not as a single global ob_beat key (marker '#3').
A denied or failed geolocation offers a way forward (typed area / skip) instead of looping the same CTA (marker '#4').
A blank area doesn't create a placeholder — the beat keeps asking until there's something real or the user skips (marker '#5' in UserOnboard).
The beat transition timer is cleared on unmount (marker '#6').
Beats can be stepped back through (marker '#7'); E2E critical/customer-onboarding walks OTP → terms → street → interests → home.
Skipping location leaves the feed in its no-location state and the app keeps offering to set an area, rather than ranking against nothing (marker '#8').
An avatar can be added any time from Profile → Edit; asking during onboarding is an extra beat between a new user and the app. A v1.1 question, deferred under decision D17 (owner to confirm).
The phone number is the OTP-verified sign-in identity, so it's already collected before onboarding starts (see PROFILE_PRIVACY PROF-1).

The notification radius has a sensible default and its own control in Settings → Notifications; a slider mid-onboarding asks for a decision before there's anything to notify about. Deferred to v1.1 under decision D17 (owner to confirm).
A contact phone is collected in the provider flow (marker '#1' in ProviderOnboard.tsx).
A proposed category writes the proposed row's own id, not NULL (marker '#2').
Portfolio photos can be removed during onboarding (marker '#3').
A failed upload leaves the form usable and retryable, and uploaded URLs are cleaned up if the create fails (marker '#4').
A signed-out visitor is sent to sign in before the form (marker '#5').
addRole is awaited before refreshUser (marker '#6').
Availability hours are kept when bookings are switched off (marker '#7').
Category chips render the full name in a wrapping row (same markup and .chip styling as the business flow, #14).
Continue explains what's missing rather than silently disabling on absent coordinates (marker '#9').
The status and verification copy agree — the confirmation says what happens next and the console's verify tile reads the real verificationStatus (marker '#10', and PROVIDER_VERIFICATION PVER-3).
Finishing switches context to the new provider profile and lands on its console (marker '#11').
The provider form keeps a per-user draft (marker '#12').

A converted guest returns to where they were: the onboarding finish consumes a stored returnTo, and the account gates keep it (E2E-029, 'Onboarding's finish() consumes this, so a shared shop link opened by a brand-new user lands back on the shop').
A guest whose location is denied or times out keeps a usable radius (GUEST_RADIUS_KM) and can set an area by hand; nothing silently pins them to Pune.
LocationPickerSheet has an explicit guest branch — 'a guest has no account, so userService.setLocation() throws 401' — and keeps the choice locally instead of failing (marker 'G3').
The guest wall explains what an account is for before sending anyone to sign in; E2E critical/guest-wall covers the browse → wall → sign-in path.
A guest sees the live queue with its numbers and a sign-in prompt to join, rather than the action simply vanishing (E2E critical/queue asserts a guest sees '2 ahead').
Catalog and booking actions are visible to guests and route into the wall (guest-wall spec), instead of being stripped from the page.

An in-context auth sheet that preserves half-typed state is a bigger change to every entry point; today the wall keeps the destination (G1) so nothing is lost but unsent text. Deferred to v1.1 under decision D17 (owner to confirm).
grep '#fff' across the guest surfaces (BusinessDetail, ProviderDetail, MyQueues, AskCompose, Search, RequestDetail): none (2026-09-16).
